9f4efd8f-b1bc-4eb0-90c2-85b0b2c24c26/Eve.en: The cold cuts deep. Grass and trees on the mountains sink into bleak stillness.<NL>From the valley drifts the fragrance of plum blossoms.<NL>The painter flicks a few strokes toward the ridge. Against wind and frost, the winter plums burst into bloom.
9f4efd8f-b1bc-4eb0-90c2-85b0b2c24c26/Eve.cn: 天寒地冻，满山草木尽数蛰伏，一片冷寂。<NL>阵阵梅香从山谷漫出，画师对着山岭偶落几笔，<NL>寒梅顶着风霜盛放，肆意傲然。
9f4efd8f-b1bc-4eb0-90c2-85b0b2c24c26/Eve.ru: Холодец режет глубоко. Трава и деревья на горах погружаются в мрачную тишину.<NL>Из долины доносится аромат цветущей сливы.<NL>Художник наносит несколько мазков по направлению к гребню. Несмотря на ветер и мороз, зимние сливы зацвели.

285a7ced-83ec-4a7b-b43c-d13a8dfc0299/Eve.en: In the deep mountains, snow falls in silence, the fragrance of plum blossoms wafts faintly, and the painter unfolds a new sheet of paper.<NL>Future encounters all hinge on a single thought—whether to brave the snow carrying a token to a rendezvous, or to drift apart in the mundane world, each going their separate way...
285a7ced-83ec-4a7b-b43c-d13a8dfc0299/Eve.cn: 深山落雪一片寂静，梅香悠悠飘散，画师又展开一幅新的画纸。<NL>往后的相逢全在一念之间，或是携信物踏雪赴约，或是各自奔波散落尘俗……

285a7ced-83ec-4a7b-b43c-d13a8dfc0299/Opt.en: (Follow the will of heaven, and part here...)
(Stay a while longer, do not leave yet...)

e0effc54-f869-464e-997e-3d304dff5acb/Eve.en: Another Lessen Cold period, meeting of soulmates...<NL>The painter takes out the Wintersweet Seal and hands it forward: "This Wintersweet Seal's essence is for you, to withstand the world's frost and wind."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gains trait: Wintersweet Pure Soul)</color>
e0effc54-f869-464e-997e-3d304dff5acb/Eve.cn: 又是小寒时节，知音重逢……<NL>画师取出梅押递上前：“这份岭梅气韵送你，为你可抵御世间风霜。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：岭梅清魄）</color>

3fcaa144-0b64-439a-91ef-e2e5a0bcd855/Eve.en: Hearing footsteps on the snow, the painter looks up. He gazes toward the distant ridge and whispers:<NL>"'Walking through Plum Blossom Ridge at Lesser Cold, walled off from the mortal world by mountains.'<NL>When I first read Su Dongpo's line, I only knew its face.<NL>Now, deep in these mountains, at last I understand the solitary purity of plum blossoms."
3fcaa144-0b64-439a-91ef-e2e5a0bcd855/Eve.cn: 听到踏雪脚步声，画师抬头，遥遥望向梅岭，低声自语：<NL>“小寒行过梅岭，群山隔绝尘嚣。<NL>从前读东坡这句诗，只知字面意思，<NL>如今在这深山之中，才算读懂梅花孤洁的意趣。”

85d23d91-1bc1-4aab-81a5-cbfc49d41a35/Eve.en: The painter points to several plum trees near and far, saying: <NL>"The 'divine essence' of the plum tree is scattered in three places:<NL>The old Red Plum Blossoms by the cliff, fearless and reckless, so take the outermost branch facing the wind.<NL>The White Plum Blossoms in the hollow, deep and forbearing, so take one bloom where the snow and ice are about to melt.<NL>The Pink Plum Blossoms halfway up the mountain are the sole warmth beyond this 'human realm'...<NL>You must take a single bloom when the slanting sunlight shines through, its quality like warm jade..."<NL>
85d23d91-1bc1-4aab-81a5-cbfc49d41a35/Eve.cn: 画师指向远近几株梅树，道：<NL>“梅树‘神韵’，散在三处：<NL>岩边老红梅，不管不顾的胆气，当取迎风最外一枝。<NL>坳底那白梅，幽深隐忍，当取冰雪将融未融的一朵。<NL>半山上的粉梅，乃是这‘人境’之外，唯一一点温存……<NL>非得取斜阳斜照时，日光透影、质如温玉的一朵才行……”<NL>

acf45648-2d58-4fb7-846a-3ae48cc3a9d9/Eve.en: The painter's hands are red from the cold, yet he looks at you sincerely:<NL>"My hands are stiff. I can hardly climb the mountain. Might I trouble you to find a few sprigs of plum blossom for me?<NL>Red plum blossoms bear courage, white ones depth, and pink ones warmth.<NL>With these three colors, I may finally paint the true soul of Plum Blossom Ridge..."
acf45648-2d58-4fb7-846a-3ae48cc3a9d9/Eve.cn: 画师双手冻得通红，恳切望来：<NL>“天寒手僵不便登山折枝，劳烦您替我去寻几枝梅花。<NL>红梅取劲骨，白梅含清幽，粉梅带温婉，<NL>集齐这三色，我才能落笔绘出梅岭的神韵。”

a24d8082-f6f9-4f88-aaba-5855ef4ec84c/Eve.en: The painter sits on the snow, unrolling his paper and setting to work. In moments, the snowy ridge and cold plum blossoms begin to take shape.<NL>The scene within is solitary and austere, yet full of hidden vitality...<NL>He sets down his brush, sighs softly at the still-wet ink:<NL>"Thanks to your help in finding the plum blossoms, the 'realm' within this painting is finally complete."
a24d8082-f6f9-4f88-aaba-5855ef4ec84c/Eve.cn: 画师就地坐在雪地里，铺开画纸落笔作画，片刻功夫，雪岭寒梅便初具模样。<NL>整幅画清冷孤寂，隐隐透着生机。<NL>他放下毛笔，望着墨迹轻叹：<NL>“多亏你帮忙寻梅，这幅画才算修成圆满。”

2500d6ab-152e-43f2-a998-921f12cae1a6/Eve.en: The painter takes out a Wintersweet Seal from his bosom, dots it with fallen plum snow and petal rouge on the painting's corner, and hands it to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>:<NL>"This Wintersweet Seal, condensed with the entire painting's spiritual Qi, I gift to you, a small token of my feelings."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gains trait: Wintersweet Pure Soul)</color>
2500d6ab-152e-43f2-a998-921f12cae1a6/Eve.cn: 画师从怀中取出一枚花押，用落梅残雪与花瓣胭脂在画角点就，递与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>：<NL>“这枚岭梅花押，凝着整幅画作的灵气，赠与你，聊表心意。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：岭梅清魄）</color>

b225bdb9-6d39-4183-9329-f9be645c309e/Eve.en: A gentle warmth lingers in the painter's eyes as he says:<NL>"If one day you return to Plum Blossom Ridge with this seal, I shall stand with you once more and admire the plum blossoms in their full splendor."
b225bdb9-6d39-4183-9329-f9be645c309e/Eve.cn: 画师眉眼带着浅淡温笑，叮嘱道：<NL>“日后你若携这枚花押重回梅岭，岁岁冬雪花开，我便再陪你共赏这岭上寒梅盛景。”
b225bdb9-6d39-4183-9329-f9be645c309e/Eve.ru: Нежная теплота задерживается в глазах художника, когда он говорит:<NL>"Если однажды ты вернешься в Плам Блоссом Ридж с этой Печатью, я еще раз встану рядом с тобой и полюбуюсь цветами сливы во всем их великолепии".

9e74a751-05fa-41ff-a59b-8423dc350c75/Eve.en: The painter's hands are red from the cold, yet he looks at you sincerely:<NL>"My hands are stiff. I can hardly climb the mountain. Might I trouble you to find a few sprigs of plum blossom for me?<NL>Red plum blossoms bear courage, white ones depth, and pink ones warmth.<NL>With these three colors, I may finally paint the true soul of Plum Blossom Ridge..."
9e74a751-05fa-41ff-a59b-8423dc350c75/Eve.cn: 画师双手冻得通红，恳切望来：<NL>“天寒手僵不便登山折枝，劳烦您替我去寻几枝梅花。<NL>红梅取劲骨，白梅含清幽，粉梅带温婉，<NL>集齐这三色，我才能落笔绘出梅岭的神韵。”

9e74a751-05fa-41ff-a59b-8423dc350c75/Opt.en: Where are the red plum blossoms?
Where are the white plum blossoms?
Where are the pink plum blossoms?

56ae6a03-7eac-432e-99a1-b1fa23516c64/Eve.en: A mid-slope blossom catches the eye—slant sunlight pierces its thin petals, casting a warmth like glowing jade...
56ae6a03-7eac-432e-99a1-b1fa23516c64/Eve.cn: ​选中半山腰的一朵，斜阳穿透薄瓣，映出温润如玉的光泽……
56ae6a03-7eac-432e-99a1-b1fa23516c64/Eve.ru: Цветок на среднем склоне привлекает внимание - косые солнечные лучи проникают сквозь его тонкие лепестки, излучая тепло, похожее на сияющий Нефрит...

c82fe9bb-7382-458e-9d94-80d80381d9da/Eve.en: You break off a small wind-facing branch from the cliffside; its petals are like cinnabar, blazing like fire...
c82fe9bb-7382-458e-9d94-80d80381d9da/Eve.cn: 折下悬崖边迎风的一小枝，瓣如朱砂，灼灼如火……
c82fe9bb-7382-458e-9d94-80d80381d9da/Eve.ru: Вы срываете со склона маленькую ветку, обращенную к ветру; ее лепестки похожи на киноварь и пылают, как огонь...

49d30732-2ecd-4522-9797-1ab1784b23bc/Eve.en: You brush away the snow and pick a blossom half-thawed, its petals pure white and icy to the touch...
49d30732-2ecd-4522-9797-1ab1784b23bc/Eve.cn: 拂去高处积雪，摘取将融未融的一朵，花色皎洁，触手冰凉……
49d30732-2ecd-4522-9797-1ab1784b23bc/Eve.ru: Ты смахиваешь снег и срываешь наполовину оттаявший цветок с белоснежными лепестками, ледяными на ощупь...

f915ef26-1d93-409b-8522-ba85eda229c1/Eve.en: The painter gazes at his own brushwork, murmuring softly:<NL>"The cool fragrance now dwells within the painting. I will wait here quietly until you return, my kindred spirit, and together we shall compose another landscape."
f915ef26-1d93-409b-8522-ba85eda229c1/Eve.cn: 画师凝望着笔下画卷，轻声喃语：<NL>“寒香尽入画中，我便在此静静等候，待知音重来，再共题山水。”
f915ef26-1d93-409b-8522-ba85eda229c1/Eve.ru: Художник смотрит на свой собственный рисунок кистью, тихо бормоча:<NL>"Прохладный аромат теперь витает внутри картины. Я буду спокойно ждать здесь, пока ты не вернешься, моя родственная Дух, и вместе мы создадим еще один пейзаж".
